The '''Viper speeder bike''' was a model of [[speeder bike]]<ref name="The Complete Season Two" /> that was in use during the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="R2 Come Home" /> and later into the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Devil's Deal">{{TBB|Devil's Deal}}</ref> A speeder bike of this model was used by the [[Klatooinian|Klatoonian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Castas]].<ref name="R2 Come Home" />
